name: After § 42
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Moldova
part_text: 42a. Notes that cross-border connectivity with the EU, including maritime, should be properly planned to facilitate business and investment promotion that will benefit European companies and taxpayers; highlights that linking Moldova to core European corridors, for example the Rhine-Danube corridor, to connect East with West would also contribute to the creation of resilient supply chains;
